description: List work orders for the shop, paged. Each order carries its number, status flags (authorized, invoiced, paid), totals in cents, workflow status and assigned technicians. For one customer's orders use shopmonkey_list_customer_orders. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/order.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for paging (use with limit).

name: shopmonkey_list_orders
title: List orders
